in_hebrew.name: Gertrudis
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Struggle, strength, ruler
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gertrudis הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Gertruda, a combination of Germanic words gis ('pledge') and trud ('strength'). The name Gertrudis symbolizes the struggle for strength and the perseverance to rule. This name was popular among medieval European women.

in_latin.name: Gertrudis
in_latin.meaning: Fortis in pugna, virtutem et fortitudinem personificans
in_latin.long_meaning: Gertrudis, nomine Latinum, a Germanico vocabulo fortis et rudis deductum, significat virtutem et fortitudinem personificans, ex Germanicis gentibus originem ducens. In Christiana traditione, Gertrudis sancta, abbatissa Saxoniae, aevi Medii, qui virtutem et fortitudinem in rebus difficillimis ostendit, celebratur.
